dreamteamer.title: Docker workspaces
dreamteamer.description: Runs a dreamteamer workspace as a local Docker container, and moves its workspaces between containers as one encrypted file. `dt-docker` is a global command needing only Node and Docker: it starts, stops, opens, lists and removes containers, each a code-server editor at a loopback URL over three named volumes. Installed in a workspace, it adds the `running-workspaces-in-containers` skill.
